deploy-bot: Canary deploy v2026.03.25-alpha started. Post-deploy smoke probes running. us-central synth shows brief spike in /chat p99 and a handful of 5xxs (3/150).

li.chen: looking at traces, errors originate from kv-warmup timeouts on first request after container start.

sre_omar: recommend region-scoped pin to previous model variant redwood-chat-v1.8.7 while we investigate. Also increase synth steady-window to 90s to avoid noisy short-window gating.

product_kate: agree. hold global rollout and pin us-central only. Update release notes to reflect mitigation.

deploy-bot: Applied region pin and hold. Monitoring now.

oncall-bot: INC-2026-03125 created and paged sre_omar.

sre_omar: post-pin quick run: 5xxs -> 0/300, p99 down to baseline. Will collect flamegraphs and file follow-up ticket.
